name: Sprewell Bluff Park, River Ridge Campground

lead.note: **4696 Sprewell Bluff follow-up (2026-10-29):** Firefly's site text: "the location is on the mountain ridge of the Flint River ... the views are spectacular" - a ridge-top riverview lead (marketing text, needs the gate's imagery look from the new pin).
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 32.8512,-84.4765: camp clearing/road strip sits behind a continuous treeline screening it from the Flint River (~60-80m, no open apron, water not visible across open ground)

lead.note: 14374 Bear Branch RV Park stored not waterfront: pin at the head of a millpond cove with RVs and pads along the cove's south shore, open to the water (George L. Smith SP millpond) (GA; p3-195)
lead.prior_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 32.54742,-82.12780: a few units at the head of a wooded cove of the George L. Smith millpond, under canopy; no pad confirmable at the water's edge - not waterfront (default down, low confidence: units appear within ~20 m of the cove)

lead.note: 4528 George T. Bagby stored lakefront: imagery predates the new campground and ReserveAmerica tags no site waterfront - re-check when newer imagery exists (GA; p3-195)
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 31.6670,-85.0598: new campground loop on Lake Walter F. George with RV sites on the outer (west) edge fronting an open grass/sand apron to the shoreline; adjacent swim beach

lead.note: 4637 River Campground & Lodge stored not waterfront: operator lists RV sites #7, #8, #9, #10 and #12 on the Tallulah River ("#9 ... is on the river"; "#10 ... view of river is obstructed"); imagery shows the site row on the north bank west of Joy Bridge Rd; river ~20-28 m wide, so creekside if the site-level check (bank height, screening) passes (GA; p3-196)
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 34.7759,-83.3992 (Soque River): continuous treeline buffers the river bank; open field set back behind it and cabins in woods, no RV pad on an open riverbank apron

lead.note: 14373 A Big Wheel (weak): operator prices "Daily Pond Rates" sites; imagery shows the RV row ~80-100 m from a small pond across open grass - not waterfront probably stands (GA; p3-197)
lead.prior_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 30.8373,-81.5645: RV rows among live oaks west of the highway; a small pond in the park's south corner is not at the rows and Crooked River is off-frame - not waterfront

lead.note: 174 Blythe Island: county calls sites 1-13 "RV Lakeview Sites" ("lovely view of Lake Cindee", a small swimming lake); stored not waterfront (from the AWH note's "not confirmed") - re-audit for lakeview. 182 Cat Head Creek: a ~1.5 ha pond lies against the west row of the RV loop. 4601 Currahee: back-in sites on a creek with decks ("#15 Full hookup on a stream") (GA; p3-198)
lead.prior_evidence: Firsthand manual audit by owner (--AWH note); waterfront 'not waterfront' per owner: Campground is on a small lake, and some sites may hav a water view, but this is not confirmed.

lead.note: 4524 Florence Marina (STRONG, downward): stored lakefront unsupported - the park map puts the campground east of the park road with the clubhouse, picnic area and mini-golf between it and the reservoir; imagery ~100 m from shore behind a field and trees. Likely not waterfront (GA; p3-199)
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 32.0858,-85.0432: open-grass/lawn campground loop with RV sites and an unobstructed open apron running to Lake Walter F. George (Eufaula) shoreline; RVs parked at lakeside edge

lead.note: 4556 Doll Mountain (upward): recreation.gov tags RV site 12 and tent sites 19, 20, 34-37, 45 "Lakefront"; stored not waterfront (GA; p3-199)
lead.prior_evidence: rec.gov sites 19/34/35/37 carry Lakefront proximity but are TENT ONLY (15ft max vehicle, no RVs); RV/drive-in sites are heavily wooded and set back from Carters Lake
